model_definition.geometry: unit square-prism bar, length L=1, section A=1
model_definition.boundary: all translations fixed on x=0 face; all four x=1 face nodes receive UX=250
model_definition.topology: compatible structured HEX8 sequence; same physical domain and load transfer at every level

observable.name: q
observable.definition: arithmetic mean of UX at the four x=1 face nodes

reference.name: q_ref
reference.justification: dimensional axial-response scale for the declared unit bar; used in the approved normalization, not as a claim of exact 3-D end-effect solution
